key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:0F96
name: set_state_seven_call_library
description: Stores seven in a global state word and saves the parameter in a second global word. It then calls a library routine through a function pointer, runs cleanup routines when the state word is not six, and returns the saved parameter.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:0FDC
name: set_state_ten_call_library
description: Stores ten in a global state word and saves two parameters in global words. It calls a library routine through a function pointer and runs cleanup routines when the state word is not six.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:102E
name: write_and_verify_dungeon_save
description: Builds a save record in memory and writes it to a dungeon save file, referencing the original and temporary dungeon file names, then reads the file back and compares its length. It returns a failure code of one or two when the disk check or the readback length does not match, and zero on success.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1248
name: lock_game_disk_and_prompt
description: Locks the game disk and loops while a disk status check reports a problem, showing the matching message text (disk is full, or disk is in use) for each status. It unlocks the disk when the check is clear.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:139A
name: process_sprite_entries_until_done
description: Loops over sprite entries, dispatching on a type value of two or eight and on a code value. The loop ends when the code value fifteen is seen, after which it makes final helper calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:14DA
name: initialize_sprite_grid_entries
description: Clears a global counter and runs setup helpers, then loops four times over six positions, calling a helper for each cell. It makes further setup helper calls afterwards.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1668
name: compute_nine_sprite_offsets
description: Runs a counted loop nine times, calling the sprite offset helper once per iteration.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:16CA
name: forward_to_sprite_offset_helper
description: Does nothing except call the sprite offset helper routine and return.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:171E
name: store_sprite_position_value
description: Computes a value from a column variable and the entry index times nine, minus one, and stores it in a per-entry table. It then calls two helpers and passes the entry index to a third.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:176A
name: configure_sprite_render_params
description: Sets render parameters for the current sprite entry using the constants 149, 33 and 16 and a position derived from the entry index. It calls helpers to set the entry and then finish rendering it.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1806
name: select_sprite_draw_routine
description: Compares a column value against the current entry index, then switches on a difference computed from stored position values. Odd cases call one rendering helper and even cases call another, followed by three further helper calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1908
name: find_entry_covering_point
description: Scans ten entries of a global table, each giving the origin of a fixed-size box, and checks whether the given x and y coordinates fall inside that box. It returns the one-based index of the first match, or zero if none matches.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:196E
name: transfer_counter_between_fields
description: For an entry whose counter is not twenty and whose second counter is nonzero, it moves one unit from the second counter into the first and calls two helpers. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1AD2
name: branch_helpers_on_tens_quotient
description: Reads a value from a table indexed by the parameter and divides it by ten. If the quotient is zero it calls three helpers, otherwise it calls two.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1BEC
name: render_text_entry_string
description: Looks up a text entry in a global table and calls helpers to compute its length and position. It draws the text, and when a second parameter is nonzero it draws again with a fixed mode argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1CD8
name: clear_flagged_sprite_slot
description: Looks up the slot for the current index and, when a helper returns a nonzero value, reads two status flags. It clears either the entry before the match or the match itself, depending on those flags, then calls helpers to refresh it.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1D0E
name: clear_slot_with_flag_check
description: Reads status flags and clears either the entry before the given index or the entry at the current index. It then calls two helper routines to refresh it.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1D3E
name: clear_previous_entry_and_refresh
description: Clears the entry one position before the given index, then calls helpers including one with the value one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1D8E
name: store_entry_value_clear_next
description: Looks up a value for the entry at the current index. Unless that value is twelve and a second helper returns zero, it stores the second helper's result at the looked-up position and zeroes the following byte, then calls helpers.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:1E42
name: find_index_in_short_table
description: Scans a table of twenty-six words for the parameter value. It returns the matching position offset by sixty-five, or zero when no word matches.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:200E
name: run_helper_then_library_call
description: Calls a helper routine, then makes an indirect call through a library pointer in the global base and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2036
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls a helper and then invokes the Exec memory allocation through a library pointer, without keeping the returned block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2068
name: initialize_graphics_library
description: Allocates a control block, stores the custom chip base address in it, and opens graphics.library. It allocates a memory block for each entry in a pointer list and copies a table of values into the block; on failure it runs cleanup and returns a step number.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:214C
name: call_two_helpers_sequentially
description: Calls two helper routines one after the other and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2178
name: run_library_list_sequence
description: Calls one library function, then walks a list of two-word records calling another library function for each entry until a marker value is reached. It finishes with a third library call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:21BC
name: return_without_action
description: The body is a bare return with no operations, so calling it does nothing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:21CA
name: free_blocks_and_close_library
description: Walks two pointer tables and frees each non-null memory block with the Exec free routine. It then closes a library if its stored handle is set and frees the final block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:222E
name: initialize_custom_chip_state
description: Copies two words from one state structure into another, clears all interrupt enables, and writes saved copper list pointers into the custom chip. It then sets interrupt enables and DMA channels and calls helpers to build lists.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:22B0
name: restore_custom_chip_registers
description: Disables interrupts, writes saved copper list pointers and a saved interrupt word back to the custom chip, and enables DMA channels from a masked saved value. It finishes by writing a constant to a global.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2338
name: wait_for_vblank_then_clear
description: Polls the interrupt request word until the vertical blank bit is set, then clears that bit by writing it back to the interrupt request register. It returns the masked bit value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:234A
name: wait_for_vblank_repeatedly
description: Repeats the vertical blank wait and clear the number of times given in the input value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2362
name: repeat_clear_and_wait_flag
description: Computes a repeat count from the input value and a structure field, then repeatedly clears a flag byte and waits for it to become nonzero, decrementing the count each time.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:237A
name: call_single_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns without doing anything else.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2388
name: build_copper_list_commands
description: Writes a sequence of copper list words into memory, including bitplane pointer pairs from global data, a color table copied from a global array, and a wait-and-end sequence. It saves the end of the written list in a global structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2634
name: copy_long_blocks_to_buffer
description: Copies seventeen longwords from a fixed source block into a buffer, then copies seventeen more from a later point in the source into a second region of the buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2666
name: return_pointer_plus_offset
description: Returns the address held in a global pointer, advanced by ninety-six bytes.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2676
name: store_word_in_global_slot
description: Writes the word passed in the data register into a fixed field of a global structure and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2680
name: fill_copper_entries_by_condition
description: If the helper returns zero, it clears a flag and fills fourteen longwords with one fixed pattern. Otherwise it fills seven longwords with a second pattern and sets the flag.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:26C4
name: copy_global_words_into_buffer
description: Stores a helper result and a minus-one marker in a state structure, then copies six words from a global area into a buffer with eight-byte spacing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:26EE
name: update_frame_and_clamp_positions
description: Toggles a frame parity byte and increments a frame counter. When a flag is set it copies twelve words into a buffer and sends a value from a global table, then moves each object and clamps its new position between stored minimum and maximum values before calling helpers.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:272C
name: indirect_call_unrecovered_target
description: Makes an indirect call through a jump table that the decompiler could not recover, so the target is not known from this code alone.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2730
name: acknowledge_masked_interrupt_flags
description: Writes the masked interrupt request bits back to the interrupt clear register, then sets a flag byte to one in the state structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2748
name: write_eight_after_helper_call
description: Calls a helper, then writes the value eight to a fixed custom chip word and returns the data registers unchanged.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:275C
name: indirect_call_unrecovered_handler
description: Makes an indirect call through a jump table that could not be recovered, so the handler it reaches is not known from this code alone.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2760
name: advance_countdown_and_refill
description: When an enable flag is set, decrements a countdown and, on reaching zero, toggles a state word. It then refills seven table entries from a fixed pattern or from global data, resets the countdown, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2790
name: reset_countdown_and_copy_words
description: Sets a countdown to twenty-six and copies seven words from a global area into a buffer, then makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:27BA
name: flush_pending_entries_to_buffer
description: When the pending flag is set, copies twelve words into a buffer and, if the index is nonnegative, fills seven entries from a global table at that index. It then makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2820
name: initialize_input_state_counters
description: Sets a buffer pointer one thousand twenty-four bytes past a base and clears several counters. It reads a byte from global data, stores it along with a tenth of its value, sets fields to constants, and calls helpers to set up the initial input state.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2878
name: advance_queue_every_third_frame
description: When an enable flag is set and the frame counter is a multiple of three, reads the next value from a pointer-based sequence and stores it in a structure field, using a default when the entry is zero. It then makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:28EE
name: store_helper_result_and_dispatch
description: Stores a helper's two result bytes in the state structure, calls another helper, then makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2902
name: process_input_region_changes
description: Records two input bytes and, when a byte changes, scans a table of rectangular regions for the current position using a flag bit for each byte. A match triggers a helper call, and the routine ends with an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2922
name: check_regions_for_input_change
description: Scans a table of rectangular regions for the current position where the first flag bit is set and calls a helper on a match. It then handles the second input byte the same way with a second flag bit, updates the stored bytes, and decrements a counter before an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:295A
name: check_second_byte_regions
description: When the second input byte has changed, scans the region table for its flag bit and calls a helper on a match. It then updates the stored input bytes, decrements a counter, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:296A
name: compare_second_byte_and_dispatch
description: Calls two helpers first, then if the second input byte has changed, scans the region table for its flag bit and calls a helper on a match. It stores the input bytes, decrements a counter, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:298E
name: scan_regions_then_store_input
description: Walks the region table until a terminator, calling a helper for the first region whose flag bit is set and contains the current position. It then stores the input byte values, decrements a counter, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:29C6
name: store_input_state_and_dispatch
description: Calls helpers, stores the returned input bytes into the state structure, calls another helper, and decrements a counter. It finishes with an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:29D6
name: refresh_input_state_and_dispatch
description: Calls a helper, stores its returned input bytes, calls another helper, and decrements a counter. It then makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2A1C
name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Decodes a byte from the keyboard serial register when its data-ready flag is set, inverting and rotating it into a key code. It records key presses and releases in a bit table for a range of key codes, toggles the handshake flag around the read, and returns the code or minus one when nothing is decoded.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2A7A
name: set_key_state_bit
description: Sets one bit in a key state byte, selected by the low three bits of the input, and returns minus one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2A82
name: read_key_state_byte
description: Returns the byte stored at a fixed offset from a global pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2A8E
name: reset_fields_and_clear_block
description: Sets several byte and word fields of a state structure to constants, then clears a block of 336 words that a pointer in the structure refers to.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2AC0
name: scroll_buffer_column_and_update
description: Advances a countdown and, when it passes below zero, copies eight byte rows into a buffer at an offset that wraps every forty-two bytes. It steps a row index up or down through a global table, copies seven words from that row into a target, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2AE6
name: copy_byte_rows_on_countdown
description: When the state byte is nonzero and its countdown falls below zero, copies eight byte rows into a buffer at an offset that wraps every forty-two bytes. It then steps a row index, copies seven words from a global table into a target, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2BC6
name: step_row_and_copy_table
description: Increments a row index unless it is already eight, then copies seven words from a global table at that row into a target. It finishes with an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2BF6
name: fetch_value_then_run_helper
description: Calls a helper to fetch a value, runs a second helper, and returns the fetched value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2C16
name: read_next_ring_buffer_entry
description: Reads the next byte from an eighty-entry ring buffer, moving the read position backwards with wraparound. It returns the byte minus thirty-two, multiplied by eight, or returns zero and clears a flag when the buffer is empty.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2C3E
name: clear_active_flag_and_return
description: Clears a state flag byte and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2C46
name: write_string_until_terminator
description: Walks a null-terminated string, calling a helper for each character and setting a flag after each call. It stops at the terminator and returns zero, or returns a nonzero helper result early.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2C68
name: write_byte_to_ring_buffer
description: Stores the low byte of the input at the tail position of an eighty-entry ring buffer and moves the tail backwards with wraparound. When the buffer would become full it returns one and leaves the tail unchanged, otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2C8C
name: set_ring_tail_index
description: Stores the input word as the ring buffer tail index and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2D2E
name: decrement_countdown_fields
description: Decrements each nonzero countdown in a table of ten words, then makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2D44
name: initialize_object_state_defaults
description: Sets coordinate, velocity and bound fields of a state structure to fixed constants and clears its position fields. It copies a word from another structure into two byte fields, initializes three words, and calls a helper.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2DCC
name: step_position_and_clamp_bounds
description: If the state byte is zero, clears a set of counters. Otherwise it advances the position by a velocity from a helper result or a stored velocity sum, clamps the result between stored bounds, and calls two helpers before an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2E40
name: clamp_position_then_dispatch
description: Clamps the x and y values against stored minimum and maximum bounds, stores them as the current position, calls two helpers, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2E56
name: clamp_y_and_store_position
description: Clamps the y value against its upper bound, stores the x and y values as the current position, calls two helpers, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2E74
name: add_velocity_and_clamp_position
description: Adds stored velocity values to the current position, clamps the result between stored minimum and maximum bounds, stores it, calls two helpers, and makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2E86
name: clear_counter_blocks_and_dispatch
description: Clears several longword fields in two blocks referenced by pointers in the structure, then makes an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2EA6
name: compute_wrapped_byte_deltas
description: Stores the new low and high bytes of a position and returns the two differences from the previous values as signed deltas that wrap around 256.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2EE6
name: compute_mirrored_motion_deltas
description: Computes two signed motion deltas, one from an input value reflected around 255 and one from the difference of two inputs, each folded into a signed byte range and sign-adjusted by a direction flag.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2F0E
name: return_immediately
description: The routine body is a single return with no operations, so calling it does nothing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2F24
name: record_history_and_store_values
description: Stores the current position in a four-entry history table at the current index, steps that index backwards with wraparound, and writes either a helper's result or zeros into two pairs of words in a state structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2F7A
name: update_secondary_counter_and_write
description: Decrements a counter with a lower bound, calls a helper, and zeroes its results when a field is zero. It writes the result words into several offsets of a table, including a copy offset by eight.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:2FF2
name: compute_input_status_word
description: Adds two offset values to input coordinates, derives status bits from the sums and the low bit of the first value, and returns a combined value with bit seven set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:303E
name: test_fire_button_status
description: Returns minus one when bit six of a global status byte, which mirrors the fire button register, is clear, and zero otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3052
name: capture_mouse_counters_safely
description: Disables interrupts while it copies the input flags and the mouse movement counter into a state structure, then re-enables them if they were enabled before.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:308C
name: store_position_with_interrupts_off
description: Disables interrupts, stores two input words as the current position, and re-enables interrupts if they were enabled before.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:30BA
name: store_velocity_words
description: Stores the two input words as velocity values in a state structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3200
name: dequeue_pending_entry_with_wait
description: Takes the oldest entry from a ring of 128 pending records, waiting while a count is nonzero and a flag is set. It copies the record's two longwords into the output, advances and wraps the read index with interrupts disabled, and returns an empty record when nothing is queued.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:32C8
name: reset_pending_queue
description: Clears the queue counters and zeroes the two longwords of each of 128 queue records, toggling interrupt enables around the update.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:330C
name: set_state_word_to_one
description: Sets a state word in the structure to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3318
name: clear_state_word_to_zero
description: Sets the same state word to zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3322
name: mask_input_and_check_bit
description: Masks the input word with a fixed mask and stores it in a state structure. When the lowest bit is clear it sets a counter byte to minus one, and it returns the lowest bit.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:336A
name: enqueue_record_when_masked
description: When an input word overlaps the stored mask and the queue is not full, it finds the free end of a record list and writes the two input words and the current position into it. It stores that record pointer in a ring of 128 slots and advances the tail index.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3390
name: append_record_to_ring
description: Stores a pointer to a buffer in a ring of 128 slots, advances the slot index with wraparound, and writes two input words followed by the current position into the buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:33C0
name: scale_value_by_word_ratio
description: Multiplies the input by a stored word, divides the product by sixty, forces the result to at least one, and stores the low byte in a state field.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:33E2
name: copy_linked_records_into_buffer
description: Walks a linked list of records, copying each into a buffer with two computed values, one from the first field and an offset and one from the sum of two fields. It ends the buffer with a minus-one marker and restores an interrupt-enable bit around the update.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:342A
name: render_text_glyphs_with_blitter
description: Clears a buffer, copies glyph rows for each character of the string from two global character tables into two buffers, then sets up blitter registers and starts a blit for each of six rows, waiting for the blitter between rows.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3524
name: return_without_work
description: Contains only a return and performs no work when called.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:352E
name: initialize_buffer_pointers_and_fields
description: Points two buffer pointers at offsets inside the structure, clears several flag and counter fields, writes a fixed value to a custom chip register, and sets a counter to thirty.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3572
name: swap_buffer_pointers_after_copy
description: Copies six longwords from the current buffer into fixed fields of the state structure, toggles a buffer selector, and swaps the two buffer pointers to match. It waits for a busy flag to clear before returning.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3886
name: chain_two_helper_calls
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:38A4
name: compute_row_stride_offset
description: Multiplies the input word by 576, adds 96, and stores the result in a global offset, calling helpers before and after the store.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:38CA
name: draw_entries_until_negative
description: Walks a table of five-word entries, calling a helper for each one, until it reaches an entry whose first word is negative.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:38E0
name: draw_sprite_stripe_lines
description: Sets blitter masks and dimensions from the input record, then draws five horizontal stripe lines from a pointer table, waiting for the blitter between lines. When the low bits of the record's position field are nonzero it draws five more lines with a shifted mask.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:39F6
name: store_params_then_call_helpers
description: Stores three input parameters in global variables and then calls two helper routines.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3A54
name: call_helpers_then_bad_data
description: Calls two helper routines, after which the remaining bytes do not decode as valid instructions, so that tail is bad data rather than behaviour.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3A6E
name: draw_five_rows_then_callback
description: Stores a record pointer, computes a width from its fields, and draws five rows into the output by copying from row tables at a computed start offset. It then calls a callback stored in the structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3AFE
name: draw_sprite_segment_with_clipping
description: Stores two input words in the record and draws five rows of blitter lines for a sprite segment, with source and destination offsets chosen by a flag bit. The clipped path tests the segment against horizontal and vertical limits and returns early when it falls outside them.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3BBE
name: draw_clipped_sprite_five_rows
description: Clips a sprite's position and size against screen limits, computes a row stride and bit masks, and draws five rows through the blitter from the computed start offset. It returns early when the sprite lies entirely outside the limits.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3F36
name: write_nibble_codes_per_bit
description: Loops over sixteen bit positions, waiting for two flag bytes on each pass and calling a helper, then writes a computed value for each bit into a buffer. The input flag selects between two value sets.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:3FD6
name: decrement_nibbles_in_words
description: Walks a table of four-byte records and decrements each nonzero nibble of the word at offset two, processing the high, middle and low four-bit groups separately. It writes each modified word back in place.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4010
name: increment_nibbles_when_different
description: Compares the word at offset two of each four-byte record with the matching source word and increments each nibble that differs. It writes each result back in place.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4062
name: zero_five_longword_blocks
description: Walks an array of five pointers and zeroes two thousand longwords starting at each pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4084
name: service_four_audio_channels
description: Walks four audio channel entries from the highest index down. A type-two entry clears that channel's DMA bit, a type-one entry loads a pointer and length and sets the bit, and other entries get a default length and pointer. Each entry's counter is decremented and the routine finishes with an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:40B6
name: loop_audio_channel_entries
description: Loops over audio channel entries, setting type-one entries to a table pointer and length with their DMA bit enabled and giving other entries a default length and pointer. It decrements each entry's counter and finishes with an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:40FA
name: process_audio_channel_entries
description: Sets a default length and pointer for each audio channel entry, then enables or disables the DMA bit of type-one and type-two entries until the channel index runs out. It finishes with an indirect call through a jump table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4134
name: store_channel_sample_entry
description: Sets a channel's type code to two, stores a word parameter in a per-channel table, and stores a pointer computed from the low bits of the first argument, scaled by eight, relative to a base table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:41AE
name: forward_call_with_stack_arguments
description: Passes a fixed global buffer, the first argument and the caller's stack arguments to another routine and returns its result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:41D4
name: copy_bytes_into_buffer
description: Copies a count of bytes one at a time from a source pointer to a destination pointer, then returns the destination.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4264
name: return_without_effect
description: The body is a bare return, so calling it changes nothing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:426C
name: setup_io_control_block
description: Allocates a control block, sets its fields and writes a four-character tag into it. It then reads the input and output handles through library calls and passes them to a parsing helper, storing the result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:43FE
name: split_command_line_tokens
description: Copies an argument string into a buffer, splits it into words separated by blanks with quoted text kept together, and builds an array of pointers to the words. The array is allocated and terminated with a null pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4400
name: split_argument_string_words
description: Copies an argument string into a buffer, splits it into blank-separated words with quoted text kept together, and builds a null-terminated array of pointers to the words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:45BC
name: append_limited_string
description: Finds the end of the destination string and appends characters from the source until the source terminator or the given count is reached, then null-terminates the result. It returns the destination.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:45BE
name: append_bounded_source_text
description: Finds the end of the destination string and appends characters from the source until the source terminator or the given count is reached, then null-terminates the result. It returns the destination.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:45E2
name: read_icon_window_tool_type
description: Opens icon.library, retrieves an icon, and when its window tool type is present stores the value and a count in the given structure. It frees the icon and closes the library afterwards.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:46CC
name: concatenate_strings
description: Advances to the terminator of the destination string and copies the source string onto its end, returning the destination.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:46CE
name: append_string_at_terminator
description: Walks the destination to its null terminator and copies the source string there, including its terminator. It returns the destination pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:46E2
name: copy_string_with_padding
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination until the count is used up or the source terminator is copied, then pads the rest of the count with zero bytes. A count of zero writes nothing to the destination.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4712
name: allocate_signal_and_record
description: Allocates a signal bit, then allocates a record holding the bit, a found task pointer and two parameter fields. When the first argument is zero it calls a helper on a sub-field, otherwise it calls a library routine, and it frees the signal if the record cannot be allocated.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:47B4
name: free_signal_record
description: When the record's stored pointer is set, calls a library routine on it. It marks the record as unused, frees its signal bit, and frees the record's memory.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4806
name: format_values_into_buffer
description: Parses a format string with percent conversions for flags, width, precision and length modifiers, writing text, decimal, hexadecimal and string conversions into an output buffer. It returns the number of characters written, or minus one when a conversion is not recognized.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4CFE
name: measure_string_length
description: Advances to the terminating zero byte of a string and returns the number of bytes before it.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4D10
name: initialize_self_referencing_block
description: Sets the first word of a block to point just past itself, clears the next word, and stores the block's own address in the following word.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4D22
name: walk_record_table_with_helper
description: Walks a fixed table of twenty-two-byte records from its start to its end, calling a helper with each record's address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4D48
name: buffered_record_write_byte
description: Writes one byte into a record's output buffer, flushing buffered data through a helper when the buffer is full or the byte is a newline. It returns the byte written, or minus one when the record is invalid or the flush fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4EC8
name: close_buffered_record
description: Closes a buffered record: flushes pending data when needed, closes its handle through a helper, and clears its counters and flags. It formats a five-digit number into a temporary string when a field is set, and returns zero when both steps succeed or minus one otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4EEA
name: close_buffered_record_inline
description: Performs the same close sequence as the main close routine, working directly on the record pointer held in a register. It clears the record's counters and flags and returns zero when both steps succeed or minus one otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4F8C
name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4F92
name: flush_one_or_all_records
description: When given no record, flushes every open record in the table and returns minus one on the first failure, otherwise it flushes the given record and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4F96
name: flush_one_or_all_entries
description: When given no record, flushes every open record in the table and returns minus one on the first failure, otherwise it flushes the given record and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4FD4
name: flush_records_until_failure
description: Walks the record table forward from its current position, flushing each open record that lacks the excluded status flags. It returns zero when the table is exhausted and minus one as soon as a flush fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:4FE6
name: invoke_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns without other work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:500E
name: return_no_operations
description: Contains only a return and performs no operations.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:501C
name: negate_result_if_negative
description: Calls a helper, then negates the value it returns when the first input is negative, and returns the adjusted value together with the second input.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5036
name: call_helper_return_register_pair
description: Calls a helper and returns a pair of values: the second input register unchanged and the register the helper left behind.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5042
name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Makes a single call to one routine and returns without other work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:504C
name: divide_longs_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit unsigned value by another 32-bit value, using shift-and-subtract when the divisor exceeds 16 bits and word division otherwise. It returns the quotient and remainder packed into one 64-bit result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:509C
name: allocate_node_buffer
description: Looks up a value for the record, allocates a block of one thousand twenty-four bytes for it when needed, and sets the record's buffer pointers and flag bits. When no block is available the record points at its own inline storage.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5112
name: unlink_and_free_node
description: Searches a singly linked list for the given node, unlinks it when found, and frees its memory with the Exec free routine. It returns zero when the node is not in the list.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5122
name: remove_list_node_and_free
description: Walks a linked list to find the given node, unlinks it, and frees it through the Exec free routine. It returns zero when the node is not present.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5138
name: unlink_known_node_and_free
description: Unlinks a node from a list using its predecessor pointer, or the list head when there is no predecessor, and frees it through the Exec free routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5140
name: pop_list_head_and_free
description: Moves the list head to the next node, then frees the old head node with the Exec free routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:515A
name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Walks the global node list, freeing each node through the Exec free routine, then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5164
name: free_node_chain_from_pointer
description: Walks a chain of nodes starting from the given pointer, freeing each node through the Exec free routine, then clears the global list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:518A
name: allocate_and_link_node
description: Allocates a block of the requested size with the Exec allocator and links it at the front of a global list, returning the address past the link fields. It returns zero when the size is zero or the allocation fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:51D4
name: copy_string_to_destination
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer through the null terminator, then returns the destination pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:51E2
name: check_file_handle_interactive
description: Checks that a file slot index is in range and open. It returns minus one with an error code of three when it is not, otherwise one if the stream is interactive and zero if not.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5244
name: seek_file_slot_position
description: Validates a file slot index and seeks within it through the DOS routine. When the seek fails it records the DOS error code and returns minus one, otherwise it returns the seek result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:52D4
name: delete_file_and_record_error
description: Attempts to delete a file through DOS. On failure it records the DOS error code and returns minus one, otherwise it returns zero.

name: write_to_file_slot
description: Validates a file slot and checks that it is open for writing, storing error codes three or six when it is not. It seeks first when a flag bit is set, writes through the DOS routine, and records the DOS error code when the write fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:53B8
name: check_status_bit_twelve
description: Calls a library function and tests bit twelve of its result. When the bit is set it returns the result unless a stored flag is set, in which case it calls a helper, and otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:53EE
name: write_four_bytes_then_helper
description: Writes four bytes from a global buffer through the DOS output routines, then calls a helper with the value one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:5428
name: run_callback_list_then_cleanup
description: Calls each function pointer in a global list in turn, unlinking entries as it goes, then calls a final cleanup routine when one is set. It invokes a helper with the input value afterwards.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:545A
name: release_all_resources
description: Runs a validation helper for each index of a table and frees the table, then calls a stored callback. It releases library and device resources depending on which global handles are set and returns its input value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfp:0:55B4
name: return_no_effect_stub
description: A bare return with no operations.

name: close_file_slot
description: Validates a file slot and closes its DOS handle unless a flag bit is set, then clears the slot. It returns zero on success, or minus one with an error code of three for an invalid slot.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:0000
name: run_program_main_loop
description: Opens the DOS, graphics and intuition libraries through Exec and copies startup values into globals. It runs setup helpers in sequence, then waits in a loop on a state flag before running further helpers.

name: check_fire_button_clear
description: Returns true when bit six of a global hardware status byte is clear, which the register note links to the fire button input.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:02F2
name: check_hardware_flag_clear
description: Returns true when bit two of a byte in a fixed hardware register is clear.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:0306
name: wait_for_ready_flags
description: Returns immediately when a first state word is zero. Otherwise it waits until a second state word becomes nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:0314
name: update_counters_at_frame_top
description: Repeats 105 times: disables interrupts, waits for the top of the frame, decrements the counters in three table entries, writes a scaled value of each into a target, then re-enables interrupts.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:037C
name: open_file_resource
description: Opens the file named by a text reference through DOS, stores the returned handle in a structure field, and returns true when the open failed.

name: copy_block_words_from_offset

name: clear_and_copy_block
description: Calls the graphics block-clear routine through a pointer, then copies eight thousand longwords from a block offset by twelve thousand longwords into the buffer's start.

description: Walks a table of nonzero short entries, calling DOS Read through a pointer for each one, and stops at the first zero entry or when a flag in the structure becomes nonzero.

name: fade_palette_down_steps
description: Runs sixteen steps, each waiting for two top-of-frame events, decrementing the color nibbles of a palette list and loading the palette. It then clears a word in the structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:053A
name: decrement_palette_nibbles
description: Walks a list of words for the given count, decrementing each nonzero four-bit component and writing each word back in place.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:0572
name: fade_palette_up_steps
description: Runs sixteen steps, each waiting for two top-of-frame events, incrementing the color nibbles of a palette toward its target and loading the palette. It then sets a word in the structure to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:05B8
name: increment_palette_nibbles_toward_target
description: Compares each word of a source list with the matching target word and increments each four-bit component that differs, writing the results back in place.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:0608
name: blit_five_blocks_per_row
description: Takes ownership of the blitter, then for each of sixteen rows sets masks, moduli and pointers from global tables and starts five blits, waiting for each blit to finish before the next. It releases the blitter at the end.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:071A

A channel with a small index uses a fixed buffer with length one, while other channels use the entry length or the requested length.

description: When bit zero of the input is set and a pending pointer field in the structure is nonzero, copies that pointer and a word into the destination named in the structure. It returns the input shifted right by one bit.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)(disk 1 of 3)[cr conspiracy]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr Conspiracy].adf:bcdfq:0:086A
name: service_audio_channel_state
description: When a channel-active word is nonzero, stores a helper's result in a global, calls three helpers, and copies a pending pointer and word when bit zero of the helper result is set. It returns the result shifted right by one bit, or zero when the channel is inactive.
